intent: Canonical-only environment_manager release fixing false open/unknown window interlock holds in a monitored room with no selected window contact. Retain actual selected/discovered contact fail-closed behavior, PID/Automatic activation and all five room heat/cool/humidity presets. Release only after Python 3.13/3.14, HACS/Hassfest, installed HA 2026.10 and exact flat-tag extraction checks.
note: Make unconfigured windows optional for room climate controllers while continuing to block open, missing or unavailable configured contacts.
changes: Monitored rooms without any window contacts no longer require one solely to operate the authorized physical climate controller
Explicitly selected or discovered window contacts must still be closed and valid; unknown/open/missing configured contacts block actuation
Fallback controller plan uses the same optional-window semantics as the primary room plan, including explicit empty selection
Regression-test the previous PID startup stall for an eligible room with no window contact and strict fail-closed behavior for a missing selected contact
Preserve Comfort/Home/Away/Sleep/Eco per-room heating/cooling/humidity targets and native Automatic/PID/Manual power control with physical safety guards
Canonical domain environment_manager only; no legacy-domain migration; flat HACS release payload
